description: Implementation of the ProgramNULL class methods for the ANGLE project, providing stub functions for shader program operations in a null renderer context.

classes.name: ProgramNULL
classes.description: A null implementation of a shader program used in the ANGLE graphics library.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a program, returns a LinkEvent indicating continuation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the program state to a stream (empty implementation).

methods.name: setBinaryRetrievableHint
methods.description: Sets whether the binary is retrievable (empty implementation).

methods.name: setSeparable
methods.description: Sets separability of the program (empty implementation).

methods.name: link
methods.description: Links the program, returns a LinkEvent indicating continuation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the program, always returns true.

methods.name: setUniform*
methods.description: Set uniform variables of various types (empty implementations).

methods.name: getUniformuiv
methods.description: Retrieve uniform unsigned int values (not implemented).

methods.name: setPathFragmentInputGen
methods.description: Set fragment input generation mode (empty implementation).
